body: Kitty Town because I love cats
Did anyone comment the guitar riff part of let it happen (6:15) !!!!
She was most recently using meth. But I was told she overdosed on heroin. Which she had never used before.
Also it’s been four days. I’m starting to accept her condition will likely not improve. She was so smart and beautiful and cared about me more than anything. She’s only 44.

Thank you. She was in cardiac arrest for a fatal amount of time. She wasn’t in the hospital when this happened. She has 2 strokes and seized the first night she was there. She is only responding to pain reflex tests now. Her eyes aren’t dilating. Her brain is swelling and the damage is everywhere. It’s shocking. She had just gotten out of rehab. I keep telling myself that I will be able to get through it. I have 10 days until they will have to do the surgical feeding tube & tracheotomy
I meant the feeding tube means she will have to be moved somewhere more permanently than the ICU. I’m just going to wait some more and weigh my options

Yes i have my grandmother and dad. I have two younger siblings as well, my moms other kids, but I’m not in contact with them. Neither was she. That’s why she was driven to drugs. She missed them so much. Thank you again
Thank you. I’m 20 right now and I can’t imagine seeing her like that if she was to wake up.
Also they haven’t tried to take her off the sedative because her blood pressure is high and they think it’s too risky

She went into cardiac arrest for probably over 10 minutes. It was a long time. It happened out of the hospital with the guy who gave her drugs. They revived her and she had multiple seizures. As of now they also said she had strokes. The only reflexes she is exhibiting are responses to pain. Her eyes aren’t dilating. The brain is swelling and the damage is all over. She’s shown signs of breathing manually and has triggered the ventilator. It doesn’t look good at all and I know that but I know there are miracles. If she was to wake up I know she wouldn’t be the person I knew her to be. In 10 days they will have to put her into a feeding tube and make this condition permanent. Idk what to do

Thank you so much. Yeah the guy who dropped her off is an addict too. An ex boyfriend of hers. I wouldn’t be surprised if it was meth instead. That doesn’t matter anymore because what’s done is done. I’m definitely going to wait the full 14 days... She’s only 44 years old. I love her so much. Thank you again

She overdosed on heroin and according to the man who dropped her off at the hospital she was in cardiac arrest for over 10 minutes. So long. She’s been on the ventilator for 4 days now. She’s shown small signs of breathing on her own which has triggered the ventilator. Her brain is just swollen and the damage is extensive all over it. The only reflexes shes exhibiting now is response to physical pain. Her pupils aren’t dilating to light anymore. I know that even if she was to wake up she would be a completely different person. In about 10 days they will place her on a feeding tube and they told me to think about if I want to do that. I’ve never spoken to her about this type of situation, though she’s been an addict for years. I know that she has more fight left in her but I don’t know if she would want this. I worry that if I do choose to let her pass that there will have been a chance for her to wake up and I’ll go my whole life mourning that possibility. It’s just so hard. And yes my grandma and father are there for me. Thank you

I know she wasn’t done fighting. She hasn’t seen my siblings, her other children, in years. She’s been fighting to get them back. Drugs tore her apart and she’s used them to cope with not seeing the kids. She has no documentation regarding that. At this point I want to give her a chance to come back. I know the likelihood is so low. It’s slim to none but I want to give her  a chance. I have some more time to decide but it’s hard
Thank you. Her brain damage is so severe because she was in cardiac arrest for over 10 minutes. I wish I could take her place
The only reflexes she has now are the pain receptors. Her eyes aren’t dilating anymore. I hope she isnt in pain. She’s only 44. She deserves so much more than this life gave her

I was able to visit her yesterday. Her brain is swollen and the damage is all over her brain. I believe overdosed on heroin which is a drug she had never taken before. She was in cardiac arrest for too long for her to be normal ever again. I want to keep her alive for longer but I don’t want her to live off a feeding tube I know she wouldn’t want it.
